evidence.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
Hugging Face’s new robot is an adorable rollerskating duck

summary: Hugging Face announced the Microduck, an open‑source robot shaped like a duck that can rollerskate, priced at $399. The playful device is aimed at developers and educators looking for a low‑cost, customizable hardware platform.
title: Hugging Face launches $399 open‑source rollerskating duck robot, the Microduck
